peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: XYZ100 42.4% with 3/3 replicate support; NVDA 13.6% with 3/3 replicate support; MSFT 12.2% with 3/3 replicate support; AAPL 11.9% with 3/3 replicate support; AMZN 8.3% with 3/3 replicate support; GOOGL 6.9% with 3/3 replicate support; META 4.7% with 3/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Nasdaq-100
peers.reason: The closest return comparator available: a broad US equity index whose largest constituents are also the core mega-cap exposures inside SP500, so it captures the dominant systematic equity beta and growth-factor share of SP500 returns. It is also the primary hedge, and it is the most liquid index in the set at 112.294 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: A direct S&P 500 constituent and the most important single-name AI semiconductor earnings engine in the universe, making it one of the closest return drivers for the index.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: A direct mega-cap S&P 500 constituent whose cloud, software, and AI infrastructure exposure closely matches a large share of index-level earnings and valuation movement.

peers.name: Apple
peers.reason: A direct mega-cap S&P 500 constituent with very large index weight and cash-flow exposure to consumer hardware and services, making it a core return comparator.

peers.name: Amazon
peers.reason: A direct S&P 500 constituent combining U.S. consumer spending exposure with AWS cloud and AI infrastructure demand, two major drivers of index returns.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: Alphabet is a top mega-cap constituent whose advertising and cloud businesses make it a direct contributor to S&P 500 earnings and index-level movement.

peers.name: Meta Platforms
peers.reason: A direct S&P 500 constituent exposed to digital advertising and AI infrastructure spending; it is kept smaller because its return stream is close to GOOGL and more idiosyncratic than the largest index drivers.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: XYZ100 is the best available hedge for SP500's generic systematic risk: it is the only other broad US equity index in CORE_UNIVERSE and overlaps the dominant mega-cap growth exposure inside SP500, so a short XYZ100 position removes most US equity market beta while leaving only basis from SP500's broader sector mix. It is also highly liquid at 112.294 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity versus 89.359 USD millions for SP500.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
